bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/ (built-in instruments and effects), springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service)
summary: Apple's Audio Unit framework hosts third-party AU v2 and v3 plug-ins and provides the AUAudioUnit subclassing API for plug-in extensions. BifrOSt has a pure plug-in host model and an extension point model (manifests, a registry and render-resource allocation), but it loads no third-party plug-in binary and starts no separate extension process. The DAW ships its own built-in instruments and effects as JavaScript plug-in directories, which are not Audio Units. The Apple page itself marks the framework as deprecated in favour of Audio Toolbox.

features.feature: Hosting third-party AU v2 and v3 plug-ins
features.apple: AUAudioUnit, AudioUnit instantiation (Audio Unit framework landing page)
features.note: A plug-in instance ties a render unit to its parameters, presets and buses, and both AUv2 and AUv3 versions are modelled; its parameters, presets and buses are tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-43.rs, and Instance itself is covered by the host unit tests. Gap: no code loads an external plug-in binary or starts an extension process, because this system has no plug-in loader, so the row needs that loader before it can go further.

features.apple: AUAudioUnit subclassing for app extensions (landing page: Version 3 extensions)
features.note: built on parity/team-j-audio-unit; not yet verified on Midget. Pure model: the host supplies the render unit factory, allocates bus formats and render resources, and renders through the session. No extension process is started.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/fx.rs (17 effects), springboard/apps/daw/src/dsp.rs (biquad, compressor, delay, LFO, oscillator)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. DAW-only, not exposed to other apps as an audio unit; effect routing is fixed in the DAW
instrument set is fixed; sample-based instruments load from plugin.json and zones.json folders

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/devices/mod.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/store.rs (plugin ids and params); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/rack.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/params.rs (tree_from_extra, write_back), springboard/apps/daw/src/main.rs (draw_rack, rack_slide, rack_save_preset, rack_load_preset); tests: springboard/apps/daw/tests/parity_wire.rs
features.note: Built-in devices expose a parameter tree with write-back, and presets are saved, applied and written to JSON, tested headless in daw tests parity_wire. Gap: external processors, with their parameter trees and presets, are not hosted, and the rack controls are checked only on the lab machine.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/playback.rs (Player renders to a cache), springboard/apps/daw/src/conv.rs (convolver)
features.note: rendering is internal to the DAW and is not an app-facing render API

features.apple: Audio Unit host and Core Audio I/O (not a separate Apple feature row)
features.bifrost: springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (audio service owns speaker and microphone), springboard/src/media/speaker.rs (ALSA output through dl.rs)
features.note: the service exists, but the SDK has no audio module (springboard/sdk/src/ has no audio file)

features.apple: MIDI events delivered to instrument units
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/midi_events.rs; springboard/sdk/src/midi.rs (hub, events, ump); wired: springboard/apps/daw/src/midi_file.rs, springboard/apps/daw/src/midi.rs; tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs, springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-17.rs
features.note: The MIDI 1.0 parser, encoder and sustain pedal tracker, the shared routing hub and UMP conversion are tested headless, and the DAW records and schedules notes through them. Gap: no device is opened in this repository, so a real keyboard is checked only on the lab machine.

gaps: No plug-in host for AU v2 or v3, and no way to load third-party audio processors into the DAW or any app.
No app-facing audio unit or render API; the DAW's rendering and devices are internal.
No MIDI input or MIDI event API.
The audio service (springboard/audiod) has no SDK module for apps.
